stem:
A table of different properties of four samples of matter is shown.

Which conclusion can be made about the samples based on the table?

options.label: J
options.text: Sample 4 is less dense than water.

visual_elements: table with columns: Sample, Conducts Electricity, Conducts Heat, Soluble in Water, Physical State at Room Temperature; rows: 1 (No, No, Yes, Solid), 2 (Yes, Yes, No, Solid), 3 (No, Yes, Yes, Liquid), 4 (Yes, Yes, No, Liquid)
